reply.subject: Your rent-increase notice: dates and documents needed

clauses.text: You report receiving the rent-increase notice on 28 October, but the year is not stated; you also report that the increase is due to take effect on 1 February, without stating the year. The file does not include proof of receipt, so I cannot identify the applicable filing deadline or give you a specific last day from the information currently available.
Please confirm the year in which you received the notice and the year in which the increase is due to take effect, and send any evidence showing when it was delivered.

Please send the lease contract and the rent-increase notice (you offered to send a scan), together with current rent evidence, documents showing the previous rent adjustment, and the notice’s stated reasons and calculation. As the notice is reported to rely on the mortgage reference interest rate, please also send the reference-rate basis showing the old and proposed rate bases and relevant dates.
If you have correspondence with the manager about the increase, it could also help us assess any unresolved issues.

events.summary: Daniel Fischbacher veut contester une augmentation de loyer. Il indique une réception le 28 octobre, sans année, et une prise d’effet le 1er février, année également inconnue. Le motif annoncé est la hausse du taux de référence. Le workflow couvre déjà les pièces de bail, notification, réception et calcul; aucune Knowledge ne s’applique. J’ai proposé de préciser les années, d’ajouter le dépôt de la contestation à l’autorité de conciliation et d’en demander une copie avec preuve de dépôt. Selon l’art. 270b CO, le délai est de 30 jours dès réception; la date d’échéance exacte reste indéterminable sans date complète.
